headline: Fighting Flares at Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf; Colonials Hold Broad Majority
war_summary: The latest returns show Weathered Expanse changed hands again: the expanse now stands three Warden strongpoints to six Colonial, a reversal of the five-to-four Warden edge carried in the previous edition, with Crow's Nest and Frostmarch trading blows through the small hours and eleven events logged in the past two hours alone. Stlican Shelf also moved against the Colonial ledger, now five to four, Fort Hoarfrost the scene of a fresh action shortly before the press hour. Palantine Berm slipped to five Warden and two Colonial around Leiri Hermanni. Mooring County holds at eleven Warden to one Colonial, its event traffic gone quiet though casualties still run heavy on both sides. Callahans Passage remains entirely Warden and Farranac Coast entirely Colonial, the former the war's bloodiest quiet front at better than fifteen thousand casualties in a day, and Nevish Line's Grief Mother and Stonecradle's Reach and World's End continue to absorb losses. No conquest has been declared.
